def put_abstract(pmid, text):
    xml_key = get_pmid_key(pmid) + '/abstract'
    xml_gz = gzip_string(text, '%s.nxml' % pmid)
    client.put_object(Key=xml_key, Body=xml_gz, Bucket=bucket_name)
